title: Rentals
creditNote: Applied automatically to the next period.
depositNote: Refundable. Never used to settle rent.
noPeriods: No billing periods yet. They appear once the rental starts.
emptyBodyOwner: Create a rental for each tenant to track rent, charges and payments.
emptyBodyRenter: Add your rental to track what you owe and what you have paid.

charge.ifTenantLeavesMidPeriod: If the tenant leaves part-way through a period
charge.meteredProrationNote: Metered charges follow actual usage, so there is nothing to prorate.

create.title: Add rental
create.subtitle: Set the rent and charges once. Each period is calculated for you after that.
create.duplicateSubtitle: The rent, charges and terms are copied from the rental you duplicated. Pick a unit and enter this tenant's details.
create.placeByNameInstead: Enter the place by name instead
create.counterpartyHint: Optional. Useful when the other person does not use this app.
create.frequencyNote: A period is exactly {{days}} days from the start date, so it moves through the calendar rather than following calendar months.
create.startDateHint: The first {{days}}-day period begins on this date.
create.depositHint: Optional. Held separately and never used to pay rent.
create.chargesHint: Switch on only what applies to this rental.
create.plusMetered: Plus metered charges, once each reading is entered.
create.totalIsPreview: A preview. Every period's total is calculated on the server.
create.dueOffset: Days after a period starts before rent is due
create.dueOffsetHint: Defaults to the last day of the period — rent paid at the end, as is usual in Nepal. Enter 0 to charge on day one instead.
create.overdueAfter: Grace days before rent counts as overdue
create.midPeriodEnd: If this rental ends part-way through a period
create.midPeriodEndHint: This is the default. Each charge above can override it.

draft.title: Not started yet
draft.body: This rental is saved but not running. Starting it begins {{days}}-day billing periods from {{date}}.
draft.pastStartBody: This rental was set to start on {{date}}, {{days}} day(s) ago. Starting it now will immediately show that much rent as due.

delete.confirmBody: This removes it completely and cannot be undone.

picker.noUnits: This property has no units yet.
picker.noPropertiesBody: Add a property and its units first, or record the place by name.

payment.title: Record payment
payment.chooseHint: You have more than one active rental. Choose the one this payment is for.
payment.noActiveBody: You don't have an active rental to pay right now.
payment.rentNote: Applied to the oldest unpaid period first.
payment.depositNote: Kept separate from rent and never used to settle it.
payment.referenceHint: Optional. Useful for matching a bank record later.
payment.overpayNote: This is more than the outstanding balance. The extra is kept as credit and applied to the next period.
payment.existingCredit: There is already credit on this rental.

reading.title: Meter reading
reading.noPreviousHint: No earlier reading recorded. Enter the meter value at the start of this period.
reading.previewNote: A preview. The server calculates the amount that is charged.
reading.notFound: This charge is no longer on the rental.

end.explain: The rental becomes inactive and no new periods are created. All past periods, charges and payments stay available.
end.lastDayHint: The final period is charged up to this date.
end.confirmBody: Future rent periods will stop being created. Your previous accounting stays available.

validation.amountPositive: Enter an amount greater than zero.
validation.amountInvalid: Enter a plain number, for example 15000.
validation.amountTooPrecise: Use at most two decimal places.
validation.placeRequired: Enter a name for the place.
validation.dueOffsetRange: Rent must fall due within the {{days}}-day period.
validation.readingBackwards: The current reading cannot be lower than the previous one.

errors.saveFailed: We couldn't save this right now. Please try again.
errors.startFailed: We couldn't start this rental. Please try again.
errors.unitOccupied: This unit already has an active rental. End that one first.
errors.endFailed: We couldn't end this rental. Please try again.
errors.deleteFailed: We couldn't delete this rental. Please try again.
errors.notDraft: Only a rental that hasn't started can be deleted.
errors.notActive: This rental hasn't started yet, so a payment can't be recorded.
errors.paymentFailed: We couldn't record this payment. Please try again.
errors.paymentRetryable: We couldn't reach the server. Tap again — this payment won't be recorded twice.
errors.readingNotAllowed: Only the landlord can record meter readings.

edit.title: Edit rental
edit.scheduleFixedTitle: The billing schedule cannot be changed
edit.scheduleFixedBody: This rental bills every {{days}} days from {{date}}. Changing that would renumber periods that already exist, so it means ending this rental and starting a new one.
edit.dueOffsetFutureOnly: Applies to periods created from now on.
edit.placeFromUnit: The place comes from the unit this rental is attached to.
edit.endedLocked: Its records are kept as history and can no longer be changed.

charges.title: Rent and charges
charges.futureOnlyTitle: Changes apply to future periods only
charges.futureOnlyBody: Periods that already exist keep the prices they were billed at. That is what keeps past bills accurate if a rate changes.
charges.confirmBody: Periods created from now on will use these amounts. Existing periods are not changed.

payments.title: Payment history
payments.emptyBody: Payments you record against this rental will be listed here, along with the periods they settled.
